name: hud_duel_caretaker_cork_takes_no_salt
description: EV_CORK goes to the waiting cork it ran by its seq (contract-m7.md §3), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. In window 2 my CORK is lost on its way and waits with its salt; the link goes (BuildController.forget_pending), my seat is AWAY (the system command, through the turns), and the caretaker plays it: it corks for my seat with salt 0 (seq 0, its pack in plain sight). That bottle takes no salt of mine: the tray shows the caretaker's pack in it, not mine, says the caretaker uncorks it, and my lost cork's salt stays apart until its window ends. In wave 2 the caretaker uncorks its bottle itself; nothing of mine is sent and nothing fizzles.

steps.msg: key 1 corks, and the CORK never reaches the turns
my seat is away and the caretaker corked for it with salt 0; no CORK of mine ran

steps.assert: not Game._corks.has(bottle) and Game.my_bottles()[0]['id'] == bottle and not Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['caretaker'] and Game.my_bottles()[0]['pack'] == theirs
steps.msg: the caretaker's bottle took no salt of mine: it holds the caretaker's pack, in plain sight
the tray shows its pack, not as a lost salt

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1].begins_with('The caretaker corked it while you were away')
steps.msg: and says the caretaker corked it and uncorks it

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['pack'] == theirs and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 7).is_empty() and Game._corks_waiting.is_empty() and Game.my_bottles().is_empty()
steps.msg: the caretaker uncorked it itself at 3 s; nothing of mine was sent, and my lost cork went with its window
